meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成你的写作伙伴：先帮你把想法整理成提纲，再查资料补引用、改进开头钩子，并在你写每一节时给具体反馈，同时保持你的原有文风，最后做整篇润色。
howto.when: 写博客、文章、教程等需要查资料和引用的内容时，或当你要求列提纲、改进开头、给某段内容提意见时，这个技能就会接手协助。

say.text: 帮我把“远程办公的利弊”列一份文章提纲，带研究待办。
say.note: 它会先问清受众和目标，再给出结构。

say.text: 这是我写好的开头，帮我看看钩子怎么改更抓人。
say.note: 它会拆解现有开头并给出几种改写方案。

say.text: 我刚写完“常见误区”一节，请按格式给逐条反馈。
say.note: 它会列出优点、改进点和行级改写。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a writing partner: it helps turn ideas into an outline, researches and adds citations, strengthens your hook, gives feedback on each section as you write, preserves your voice, and polishes the final draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're writing blog posts, articles, tutorials, or other content that needs research and citations, or when you ask for an outline, a better hook, or feedback on a section.

say_en.text: Help me outline an article on pros and cons of remote work, with research to-dos.
say_en.note: It asks about audience and goal, then proposes a structure.

say_en.text: Here's my intro. Can you make the hook more compelling?
say_en.note: It analyzes the current hook and offers alternatives.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Common Mistakes' section. Give section feedback.
say_en.note: It lists strengths, improvements, and line edits.
